title: Frog and Crab
skill_description: Practice reading words beginning with consonant blends: l-blends (bl, cl, fl, gl, pl, sl), r-blends (br, cr, dr, fr, gr, pr, tr), and s-blends (sc, sk, sl, sm, sn, sp, st, sw).
author: FunBookies
summary: Frog and Crab become friends at the pond, where they swim, skip, and play until Crab gets stuck and Frog helps grab and free him.

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover. Ask: What animals do you see? What sounds do 'frog' and 'crab' start with? (blends: fr-, cr-)
parent_tips.during_reading: Point out blend words: frog (fr-), crab (cr-), swim (sw-), skip (sk-). Help your child blend the sounds together smoothly.
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask: What problem did Crab have? How did Frog help? What makes a good friend?

comprehension_questions.question: Where did Frog and Crab like to swim?
What did Crab get stuck in?
How did Frog help Crab?
comprehension_questions.answer: Frog grabbed Crab's hand and tugged him free

comprehension_questions.question: What did Frog and Crab learn about friendship?

pages.text: Frog said, "Come swim! The pond is fun!"
